Prior-head PR 65 CI run https://github.com/unbraind/pm-swarm/actions/runs/42782833349 passed 1189 source tests on Node 26.13.0, then c8 exhausted its approximately 4 GiB V8 heap while generating reports. value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final scoped PR 65 continuation explicitly authorizes fixing the observed CI failure. Current head 7e59834 test (26), run 42814446970, passed all 1198 source tests then c8 exhausted its approximately 4 GiB heap during report aggregation; test (22) passed. Installed c8 12 already provides --merge-async: its synchronous loader retains every raw process report before filtering, whereas the asynchronous merger reads, filters and merges one report at a time. Enable that supported streaming mode without changing source/test scope, thresholds, worker count or the production heap cap. A synthetic 125-dump corpus with large excluded vendor coverage and an actually measured authored source will exercise the real reporter under a 64 MiB heap, failing when the flag is reverted. No dependency or workflow change is required.
